strict_loop.purpose: Stable game sprite animation with locked identity and a clean loop.
invariants: The provided image is frame 0 and must match the input image exactly.
Keep one fixed camera, scale, perspective, safe rectangle, and opaque subject bounding box.
Keep every important body part visible; never crop, duplicate, merge, or invent limbs.
Use one shared palette and preserve the reference outline and accessories.
Return to the exact frame-0 pose at the end for a seamless loop.
strict_loop.prompt_suffix: Static locked camera, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no cuts, no scenery, no shadow, no text, no logo, and no watermark.

expressive_action.purpose: Readable action with animation principles while retaining a production-safe silhouette.
invariants: The provided image is frame 0 and must match the input image exactly.
Keep the same character identity, palette families, outline language, and safe rectangle.
Keep the common cell and camera stable; allow only controlled squash, stretch, anticipation, overlap, and follow-through.
Do not let expressive motion crop the silhouette or change the apparent character scale.
expressive_action.prompt_suffix: Emphasize one readable action beat with anticipation, a clear extreme, follow-through, and a controlled settle. No camera movement, cuts, scenery, text, logo, or watermark.

benchmarks.motion: one clean run cycle with alternating front and rear limbs, subtle torso bob, and controlled tail or accessory follow-through
anticipation crouch, forward jump, compact roll, recovery to the original standing pose
jump toward a ledge, hands contact the edge, pull the body up, then settle without changing the character scale
anticipation, one readable sword arc, brief follow-through, and return to the frame-0 stance
animate only the requested water ripple, grass sway, flame flicker, or tree movement while keeping the camera and composition locked
